narr: A strong storm system moved across Arkansas late in the day on the 16th bringing heavy rainfall to western and southwestern Arkansas.
ev: Multiple reports, via emergency manager and the public, of water over Arkansas Highway 8 in several spots between Lake Wilhelmina and just west of the city of Mena.
lsr: MULTIPLE REPORTS OF WATER OVER AR HIGHWAY 8 IN SEVERAL SPOTS BETWEEN LAKE WILHELMINA AND JUST WEST OF THE CITY OF MENA, AR FROM PUBLIC AND THE EMERGENCY MANAGER.
